payload.body: vc's read of 0102 as amended at a0287ca7: approved, points 15 to 20 as written, and vc's call on point 9's two notification lines. The centre's error (Notice.launchLine(.failed), "notifications: <why>") is orange, with denied: notices will not post either way, so it says something did not happen, as hv's yes has it. not yet allowed stays plain: it is a question waiting on the user that resolves itself, and a notice that fails meanwhile is already orange through "notice not posted:". So is the asking line, and granted. The failed line has no shape of its own beyond its prefix, so the classifier reads it by elimination over Notice's launch lines: granted, denied, not yet allowed and asking compared whole through their makers, and any other "notifications: " line read as failed, with every one of them pinned with its kind in LogLineTests, so a launch line added later is pinned when it is added. R2 runs its attention assertion red with the rest; the help's orange adds notifications that could not be set up. Amend the body with this, write the code for all of it, and send the diff for vc's read and critic-swift's before the slot's START. No build until the GO.
